upload_autosave_error: Couldn’t save. Retrying in a moment — your changes are kept here.
upload_autosave_limit: Draft limit reached: delete a draft to save this one.
upload_autosave_offline: Offline. Your changes are kept here and saved when you’re back.
upload_verify_email_detail: Open the link we sent you, then come back: your draft will be waiting.
upload_no_permission_title: Publishing is paused on this account.
upload_no_permission_detail: A ranger restricted uploads for now. Check Signals for the details or contact the team.
upload_draft_limit_detail: Delete a draft you no longer need to start a new one.
upload_draft_missing_detail: It was submitted or deleted. Your other drafts are still in the list.
upload_draft_other_flow_title: This draft belongs to another flow.
upload_draft_other_flow_detail: Open it where it was started to keep its steps.
upload_target_removed_detail: Removed mods can’t receive new versions.
upload_version_draft_exists_title: You already started a version for this mod.
upload_version_draft_exists_detail: Resume that draft, or continue here to start over.
upload_file_intro_mod: Drop the .zip you’d give to players. We open it in your browser first and show what’s inside before anything is uploaded.
upload_file_intro_build: Drop the blueprint .json exported by BuildShare. Its thumbnail, element count and version are read automatically.
upload_file_intro_version: Upload the new file of {name}. Its manifest id must be {manifestId} and its version greater than {version}.
upload_drop_replace: Drop another file to replace it
upload_reading_zip: Opening the zip in your browser…
upload_progress_direct: Sent straight to storage. If the connection drops you can resume.
upload_inspecting_detail: Automatic checks run on our side. You can keep filling in the other steps.
upload_ready_detail: Everything the automatic checks look for is in order.
upload_flagged_title: A ranger will look at this file.
upload_flagged_detail: Something in it needs a human check (see the warnings below). You can still submit; it goes live once approved.
upload_rejected_detail: Fix the errors below and upload it again.
upload_expired_detail: The upload expired before it was used. Upload the file again.
upload_block_wrong_type: Wrong file type. Choose the file type shown in the drop area.
upload_block_unreadable: The file couldn’t be read. Is it a valid, complete download?
upload_block_local_problems: The checks below found errors. Fix them and choose the file again.
upload_block_manifest_id_mismatch: This file is a different mod: its manifest id is {found}, expected {expected}.
upload_block_version_not_semver: Version {version} is not a semantic version (x.y.z).
upload_block_version_exists: Version {version} already exists. Bump the version in manifest.json.
upload_block_version_not_greater: Version {version} must be greater than {previous}. Bump the version in manifest.json.
upload_failure_network: The connection dropped. Your progress is kept: resume when you’re back online.
upload_failure_expired: The upload link expired. Try again to get a fresh one.
upload_failure_too_large: The file is too large for your account.
upload_failure_forbidden: Your account can’t upload right now (unverified email or a restriction).
upload_failure_rejected: The file was refused by the checks.
upload_failure_api: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
upload_build_no_thumbnail: This blueprint has no thumbnail. Add a cover in the media step.
upload_problems_label: Errors and warnings of the file
upload_entries_title: {count, plural, one {# file in the zip} other {# files in the zip}}
upload_entries_more: {count, plural, one {And # more file} other {And # more files}}
upload_flag_zip_invalid: The zip is damaged or encrypted.
upload_flag_zip_bomb_ratio: The compression ratio is suspiciously high.
upload_flag_zip_too_many_entries: The zip has too many files (5,000 max).
upload_flag_zip_slip: A path escapes the mod folder (“..” or a link).
upload_flag_absolute_path: A file uses an absolute path.
upload_flag_manifest_missing: No manifest.json was found (at most two folders deep).
upload_flag_manifest_id_mismatch: The manifest id doesn’t match this mod.
upload_flag_version_not_semver: The version is not a semantic version (x.y.z).
upload_flag_version_not_greater: The version isn’t greater than the latest one.
upload_flag_extension_not_allowed: Unusual file type for a mod.
upload_flag_extension_flagged: Executable or script: a ranger must review it.
upload_flag_blueprint_invalid: This isn’t a valid BuildShare blueprint.
upload_issue_not_an_object: The JSON must be an object.
upload_issue_invalid_id: The id may only use letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-”.
upload_issue_invalid_platform: The platform must be Client, Server or Universal.
upload_issue_invalid_log_color: The log colour must be a hex colour like #FF9900.
upload_issue_invalid_priority: The priority must be a whole number.
upload_issue_invalid_field: The field “{field}” is missing or invalid.
upload_issue_invalid_number_of_elements: NumberOfElements must be a whole number.
upload_details_intro: How your listing reads on the site. We prefilled what the file told us.
upload_details_discovery_hint: They decide where survivors find it in Explore and search.
upload_name_hint: As players call it. 2 to 80 characters.
upload_tags_full: That’s {max} tags: remove one to pick another.
upload_description_hint: What it does, how to use it, known issues. Headings, lists, images and YouTube links work.
upload_description_placeholder: What your mod does, how to use it, known issues…
upload_markdown_preview_empty: The preview appears here as you type.
upload_license_hint: What others may do with your files.
upload_source_hint: A public repository earns trust and helps others learn.
upload_nsfw_hint: Hidden from survivors who haven’t opted in.
upload_error_slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens (2 to 80).
upload_error_url: Enter a full address starting with https://
upload_error_youtube: Paste a YouTube video link (youtube.com/watch, youtu.be or shorts).
upload_compat_intro: Tell players where your mod runs. Field reports from survivors add to it later.
upload_game_builds_hint: Only tick the patches you actually played on.
upload_game_builds_failed: The game builds couldn’t be loaded. Try again later.
upload_loader_hint: The oldest RedLoader version your mod works with.
upload_platform_client_hint: Runs in the game you play.
upload_platform_server_hint: Runs on a dedicated server only.
upload_multiplayer_client_side_hint: Only the player who installs it needs it.
upload_multiplayer_host_only_hint: Only the host needs it; guests join without it.
upload_multiplayer_all_players_hint: Every player in the session must install it.
upload_dedicated_hint: Does it work on a dedicated server?
upload_safe_remove_label: Can it be removed without breaking a save?
upload_safe_remove_no_hint: Saves made with it may break without it.
upload_safe_remove_unknown_hint: Players will be told to back up first.
upload_dependencies_hint: Those in manifest.json are always required. Add optional mods and conflicts here.
upload_dependency_search: Search mods and libraries on SOTF Mods
upload_dependency_invalid_id: A manifest id uses letters, digits, “.”, “_” and “-” only.
upload_media_intro: Good images sell a mod. Listings with 3 or more images get far more downloads.
upload_cover_description: Shown on cards and at the top of the page, cropped to 16:9.
upload_cover_hint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF · up to 10 MB · at least 1280 × 720 looks best
upload_cover_build_fallback: Without a cover, the blueprint’s thumbnail is used.
upload_crop_description: Drag the frame, or focus it and use the arrow keys. + and − resize it.
upload_crop_keyboard: Arrows move · Shift moves faster · + and − resize
upload_image_wrong_type: Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF image.
upload_image_too_large: Images can be up to 10 MB.
upload_image_no_preview: Uploaded (preview on the page once processed)
upload_gallery_description: Up to 10 screenshots. Drag to order them and describe each one for screen readers.
upload_gallery_reorder_hint: Drag the images, or use the arrows, to change the order.
upload_gallery_hint: Several at once · PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF or GIF · up to 10 MB each · {max} max
upload_gallery_added: {count, plural, one {# image added} other {# images added}}
upload_gallery_skipped: {count, plural, one {# file skipped (wrong type, over 10 MB or gallery full)} other {# files skipped (wrong type, over 10 MB or gallery full)}}
upload_video_hint: A showcase or tutorial, shown after the gallery.
upload_release_intro: The version comes from manifest.json. Tell players what changed.
upload_version_pending: Choose the file first: the version is read from it.
upload_version_from_manifest: Read from manifest.json. To change it, edit the manifest and upload the file again.
upload_version_build: Builds are versioned by date: each upload is a new version.
upload_channel_release_hint: For everyone. Becomes the latest version.
upload_channel_beta_hint: For testers who want the newest changes.
upload_changelog_hint_version: Followers read this in their Signals.
upload_notify_hint: Followers of the mod get a signal about this version.
upload_review_intro: Last look before a ranger sees it. Fix the errors; warnings are advice.
upload_preflight_waiting: The checks appear once your draft is saved.
upload_preflight_file_inspecting: The file is still being checked.
upload_preflight_file_failed: The file failed the automatic checks.
upload_preflight_file_expired: The upload expired: upload the file again.
upload_preflight_file_flagged: The file needs a ranger’s review before it goes live.
upload_preflight_file_ok: The file passed the automatic checks.
upload_preflight_manifest_id_taken: Another mod already uses this manifest id.
upload_preflight_name_missing: Add a name (2 characters or more).
upload_preflight_slug_taken: You already have a listing at this address.
upload_preflight_category_invalid: The category doesn’t exist any more: choose another.
upload_preflight_tags_unknown: Some tags don’t exist any more.
upload_preflight_tags_missing: No tags: they help survivors find it.
upload_preflight_description_short: The description is short (300 characters or more recommended).
upload_preflight_description_raw_html: The description contains HTML: it will show as plain text.
upload_preflight_gallery_ok: The gallery has 3 images or more.
upload_preflight_media_invalid: An image failed: remove it or upload it again.
upload_preflight_changelog_missing: No changelog: followers like to know what changed.
upload_preflight_dependency_unknown: A dependency isn’t on SOTF Mods: players will need to find it elsewhere.
upload_preflight_target_missing: The mod of this version no longer exists.
upload_preflight_target_removed: The mod of this version was removed.
upload_quality_hint: Complete listings rank higher in Explore and get more downloads.
upload_submit_ready: Ready. A ranger reviews first publications; verified creators go live right away.
upload_submit_ready_version: Ready. Followers are notified when the version goes live.
upload_submit_blocked: {count, plural, one {# error left to fix.} other {# errors left to fix.}}
upload_success_queued_detail: {name} is in the review queue. You’ll get a signal as soon as a ranger decides.
upload_success_queued_version: The new version of {name} is waiting for a ranger. You’ll get a signal when it’s live.
upload_success_live_detail: {name} is published. Share it with the survivors.
upload_success_live_version: The new version of {name} is live and followers are being notified.
upload_new_intro: What are you sharing with the survivors today?
upload_new_mod_detail: A RedLoader .zip with its manifest.json. Six short steps.
upload_new_build_detail: A BuildShare blueprint .json. Thumbnail and stats are read for you.
upload_new_drafts_title: {count, plural, one {You have # draft in progress.} other {You have # drafts in progress.}}
upload_new_drafts_detail: Pick up where you left off, or start something new below.
upload_new_version_none: Your published mods appear here to add a new version.
upload_drafts_intro: Autosaved as you go. Up to {max} drafts at a time.
upload_drafts_empty_detail: Anything you start publishing is saved here until you submit it.
upload_drafts_blockers: {count, plural, one {# thing to fix} other {# things to fix}}
upload_drafts_delete_detail: “{name}” and its unsent files will be gone. This can’t be undone.
